title: Buying Your First Home in St. George

characters.description: cheerful cartoon honeybee real estate agent wearing a tiny navy blazer and gold name tag, big friendly eyes, expressive antennae

scenes.narration: Think you can't buy your first home in St. George? Let's bust that myth in sixty seconds.
scenes.visual: bee-agent bursting through a paper banner that reads nothing, confetti flying, sunny desert-town skyline with red rock cliffs behind

scenes.narration: Myth number one: you need twenty percent down. Most first-time buyers here put down far less.
scenes.visual: giant cracked piggy bank labeled with a percent sign, bee-agent shrugging beside a small tidy stack of coins

scenes.narration: There are loan programs built for first-timers, some with just three percent down.
scenes.visual: three friendly doors labeled with small percent tags, warm light glowing from each doorway

scenes.narration: Step one: talk to a lender before you scroll listings. Know your real budget.
scenes.visual: bee-agent at a desk with a calculator, a simple budget sheet with a big green checkmark

scenes.narration: Step two: get pre-approved. Sellers take pre-approved buyers seriously.
scenes.visual: glowing golden ticket stamped APPROVED held up proudly by bee-agent

scenes.narration: Step three: tour smart. Two or three focused showings beat twenty random ones.
scenes.visual: map of a cartoon neighborhood with three houses circled, dotted flight path of the bee between them

scenes.narration: When you find the one, your agent negotiates price, repairs, and closing costs for you.
scenes.visual: bee-agent shaking hands with a smiling young couple in front of a cozy cartoon house with a sold sign

scenes.narration: Ready to stop renting? Message The Finest Homes and let's find your first front door.
scenes.visual: bright front door opening onto sunrise over St. George red rocks, keys dangling with a tiny bee keychain
